image_manifest.description: A 3D animated game screen of a weight comparison victory. A massive pterosaur sits on one end of a seesaw grounded in the sand, while a tiny pterosaur is lifted high into the air.

text_elements.style: Blue and yellow stylized 3D block letters

characters.name: Heavy Pterosaur
characters.description: A giant, robust pterosaur with mottled orange and brown skin, seated heavily on the right side of the wooden plank.

characters.name: Light Pterosaur
characters.description: A tiny, bright green and yellow pterosaur with large expressive eyes, perched on the elevated left side of the plank.

environment_and_props.seesaw: A rustic wooden plank balanced on a log pivot; the right side is touching the sand with a subtle dust effect.
environment_and_props.background: The Solnhofen formation beach: white sand, turquoise water, and ivory limestone cliffs under a bright blue sky.
environment_and_props.watermark: A small, translucent four-pointed star flare in the bottom-right corner.
